doc_friction.issue: The proposal said 'lift about a metre' and 'sixty centimetres more'; a fixed-length screw tilted from 22 to 35 degrees raises its outlet 0.56 m, so the field height had to become 0.5 m to stay consistent. Proposals that fix one geometric number should check it against the others.

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon (headline shelf). Piece: the-screw-that-lifted-less (Ấp Cây Sung, Đồng Tháp, 2049), text only because audio is 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap. Bucket volumes computed numerically (Rorres 2000 method): 17.5 L at 22 deg, 10.3 L at 35; delivered 19.7 vs 9.8 L/s with a 5 mm gap leakage term. Adversarial re-read fixed: the noon Angelus (a solar motor can't run at the 6 pm one), outlet rise 0.56 m vs field height, and the second screw's tighter gap giving 9.6 s on the drum. All weekday claims checked in code (Easter 2049 = 18 April). Added a timeline row and a new Hearth & Horizon proposal (The box that keeps the boil, haybox cooling), because the shelf's Next up list was empty. Local checks: node --test in hearth-and-horizon 20/20; run_workflow_locally --for-changes 11/11 workflows passed; agent-cross-review and deploy jobs not run locally.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: researching and modelling screw geometry plus drafting and editing a 5,000-word short story

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
